title: A manifest that declares no privacy block interprets locally
rationale: Local-only is the default, not an opt-out: silence in the manifest means the user has authorised nothing. This is the plainest reading of ADR-0005 and the one an engine is most likely to get wrong by treating an absent block as an absent restriction.

requirement.text: A conforming Lens Engine performs all interpretation on-device unless the user has explicitly opted a Domain Scope into remote inference.

content.title: School districts weigh where student data lives

blocks.text: The district is piloting local-first software that keeps student records on classroom machines rather than in a vendor cloud.
An internal review found that 73 percent of teacher laptops were missing critical updates at the start of the school year.
